frontendVisibleHint: Show this root directory and its children in the sidebar. Page permissions remain unchanged. Takes effect after publishing.
title: Developer
subtitle: Manage resource catalogs, feature mappings and translations
messagesDescription: Manage Chinese and English text across the application, including interface labels, notices and API errors. New entries appear when used by the corresponding interface or API.

messageCategoryHint.frontend: Menu names, buttons, form labels and page notices, such as “Create user” or “Enter a username”. Also includes names maintained in the resource catalog.
messageCategoryHint.backend: Errors and validation messages returned by APIs, identified by error code. For example, USER_NOT_FOUND displays “User not found”.

resourceNamesSharedHint: Basic directory and resource names are shared by the resource tree, permission picker and menus through frontend.resources. Feature names are maintained separately in frontend.features.
resourceNameHint: Directories, resources and their menus share these names and the same resource translations in Multilingual messages. Feature names are maintained separately.
resourceNameUsage: Used by the resource tree, permission resource picker and corresponding menu
featureNameUsage: Shown in the permission feature picker
positionHint: Positions start at 1 within the full parent list, including directories, resources and references. Lower numbers appear first.
invalidPosition: Enter a whole-number position within the sibling list, starting at 1.
resourceTypeHasConfiguration: Remove menu entries, operations and features before switching to a subdirectory.
directoryTypeHasChildren: Move or delete all direct child resources and subdirectories before switching to a resource.
directoryTypeHasReferences: Manually remove this subdirectory's references before switching to a resource.
typeChangeAvailable: Switch between resource and subdirectory while keeping the identifier, names, parent and sibling position. Save to add the change to pending updates.
operationsHint: Operations are read / create / update / delete. Export belongs to read; send belongs to create.
selectResource: Select a resource or create a directory or resource
mappingHint: Permissions selecting this feature receive these button and endpoint mappings.
bufferSaved: Incomplete form input is saved locally. Apply it to include it in pending changes.
invalid: Invalid format or association; check this item
deleteConfirm: Delete this item from the local draft?
discardFormHint: Unapplied form input will be cleared. Applied draft changes will remain.
inlineHint: Edit cells directly; input is saved locally
messagePathHint: Separate nested levels with dots, for example common.draftSaved
pathCollision: A parent path is already a message; use another key
languageHint: The application supports Simplified Chinese and English.
scopeIdentifierHint: Letters a–z only. Uppercase letters are converted to lowercase.
scopeIdentifierInvalid: Enter a scope identifier using only letters a–z
scopeInUse: This scope is still used by resources or default permissions
compareHint: Compare the current local draft with the latest online data
refreshKeepsDraft: Fetching online data updates the comparison and preserves your draft.
conflictHint: Online data changed. Resolve conflicting edits to the same fields; your draft is preserved.
mergeHint: Merge results update the local draft. Online data changes only after submission.
jsonCompareHint: Local and online JSON are aligned side by side, with line numbers in the center. Use the arrows to navigate changes. Filters affect navigation only.
copyJsonFailed: Could not copy. Please try again.
noMatchingDifferences: No differences match the current filters
noDifferences: The local draft matches online data
validationHint: Missing translations are warnings. Structural errors block submission. The server validates the complete catalog again.
restrictedHint: Access to the developer page is required to view this workbench.
restored: Your unsubmitted draft has been restored. Continue editing.
catalogMissing: No valid I18N_CATALOG was found. Configure it in Dictionary Management first.
loadFailed: Could not fetch online data. Your local draft is preserved; retry when ready.
catalogDisabled: I18N_CATALOG is disabled. Enable it in Dictionary Management first.
validationFailed: Fix catalog validation errors before submitting.
submitFailed: Submission failed. Your draft is preserved; compare the latest online data before retrying.
storageFailedHint: Local storage could not be written. Unsaved input may be lost on refresh. Retry or export your draft.
externalHint: Another tab changed this draft, or the stored draft is unreadable. Writing is paused. Export your current content before reloading.
localOnlyHint: Input is saved in this browser. Online data changes only when you submit.
restoreFields: Field content, including incomplete or invalid input
restoreNavigation: Tab, selected resource, searches and expanded nodes
restoreEditor: Open form and page scroll position
storageIsolation: Drafts are isolated by environment, account and dictionary in this browser.
discardHint: Unsubmitted changes and unapplied input will be cleared and replaced with the latest fetched online data.
submitConfirmHint: The online version is checked again before submission. Changes to compare:
importConfirm: Apply the imported content to the local draft?
importHint: This replaces local edits and does not change online data.
importFailed: Import failed: use a valid schema v2 catalog or draft file smaller than 2MB.
invalidParent: Parent directory is missing, cross-scope or cyclic
languagesDescription: Manage available languages, display names, and the default language.
defaultLocaleHint: Used when the user’s language is unavailable.
scopesHint: Edit scope names in both languages and adjust their display order.
saveNodeHint: Save to add this content to the resource tree and pending local changes.
nodeIdentifierHint: Keys follow directory paths, such as admin:system:users:detail. Moving between directories migrates keys automatically.
treeHierarchyHint: Drop at a directory's center to move inside, or at row edges to reorder. You can also select a node and choose Move to. References keep their own order.
directoryContentsHint: Select this directory and choose Add to create a subdirectory or resource inside it.
noEntriesHint: Add a menu entry and page route. Its name comes from Basic information.
noFeaturesHint: Add features to configure frontend buttons and HTTP / gRPC endpoints.
unsavedNodeHint: Leaving discards this unsaved edit. Save first, or discard it to continue. Saved local changes will remain.
nodeIdentifierIncomplete: Complete the identifier by entering a name after the last colon.
nodeIdentifierScope: Keep the identifier prefix for the current scope.
nodeIdentifierCharacters: Each identifier segment must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens.
directoryIdentifierFormat: Directory keys include a scope and directory name, with optional nested directories.
resourceIdentifierFormat: Resource keys include a scope, directory path and resource name.
referencePickerHint: Click “Add reference” beside a resource, choose its operations, then confirm. Adjust existing references directly; clearing their last operation removes them. Save to apply local changes.
referenceOwnershipHint: Each reference includes only the operations listed below. Click to locate the original node. Its other operations are not automatically included. Actual grants use the configuration saved on the Permissions page.
searchReferences: Search directories or resources to reference
noReferences: No references yet. Select an existing directory or resource.
referenceInUse: This node is referenced by another directory. Remove its references first.
invalidReference: Invalid reference: check that the target exists, belongs to the same scope, and creates no cycle.
moveSiblingHint: Move among siblings in the same parent directory
orderSaved: Order saved to local pending changes
wordMigrationHint: Descendants, feature keys, translations and references were migrated. Publishing also updates existing permission records.
invalidMove: Choose a directory in the same scope without creating hierarchy or reference cycles.
identifierTooLong: The resulting word exceeds 128 characters. Shorten directory or node identifiers.
invalidAlias: Invalid identifier migration: check the former key and its destination.
useTreeToMove: Finish editing, then choose Move to or drop the node at the center of a directory in the tree.
moveDestinationHint: Append to the destination and migrate descendants, related identifiers and translations together. The move is saved locally and takes effect after publishing.
referenceOrderSaved: Reference order saved; original node order is unchanged
positionUnchanged: The node is already at this position
invalidOrder: Invalid directory order: check node ownership and references.
basicInfoDescription: Set the resource name, unique identifier and parent directory.
entriesDescription: Configure the menu identifier and page route. Menu names come from Basic information.
operationsDescription: Organize features by operation and inspect their button and API mappings.
noEntriesDescription: Resources can provide API access alone. Add an entry when a page is needed.
noMappings: No buttons or endpoints linked to this feature.
selectEntryOperations: Select operations that allow page access
enableOperationHint: Enable it to configure features and link buttons and endpoints.
resourceIdentifierChangesHint: Publishing updates resource and feature references in existing permissions. Migration information is used only for this submission. Only the new identifiers are used after publication.
groupIdentifierChangesHint: Publishing updates existing permission group references to the new identifiers. Rename information is used only for this migration. Only the new identifiers are used after publication.
allScopeDescription: Grants every permission in the current scope without configuring individual operations and features.
permissionScopeHint: This setting applies to the entire resource, across all operations. All (*) grants every permission in the current scope when an action binds this resource, without CRUD configuration.
permissionResourceHint: Use user, role, action, or another resource to grant its selected CRUD management operation. Leave blank for ordinary access.
referencePermissionHint: Select read, create, update and delete individually. Only selected operations are included in this reference; unselected or newly added operations are excluded. For a directory, the selection applies to descendants that support those operations.
referenceUnavailableHint: You cannot reference this directory, its existing descendants, or a directory that would create a reference cycle.
invalidReferenceOperations: Each reference needs at least one supported operation. Removed or unsupported operations cannot be saved.
referenceNoOperations: This node has no operations to reference
directoryCannotGrant: Directories cannot define page entries or operations. Configure permissions on resources or reference resources from the directory.
